renewal.name: Renewal
renewal.description: A slow blessing: regenerate HP each turn for 4 turns.

smite.name: Smite
smite.description: Call down light on one foe. Dusk creatures fear it.

firebolt.name: Firebolt
firebolt.description: A bolt of fire at one foe.

frost_lance.name: Frost Lance
frost_lance.description: Ice damage that also slows the target (-20 Speed, 2 turns).
frost_lance.action_string:
DAMAGE 1_ENEMY CHOICE 1.3*INT ICE
DEBUFF PREVIOUS_TARGETS SPEED 20 2_TURNS

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.description: A thread of dark that wounds a foe and draws mana back to you.
siphon.action_string:
DAMAGE 1_ENEMY CHOICE 0.7*INT DARK
RESTORE SELF MANA 4+PREVIOUS_DAMAGE_DEALT/3

e_spore_cloud.name: Spore Cloud
e_spore_cloud.message: {caster} bursts, releasing a choking yellow cloud.

e_curse.name: Bog Curse
e_curse.message: {caster} mutters, and your limbs feel heavy.

e_lantern_eater.name: Lantern-Eater
e_lantern_eater.action_string:
SET SELF charging true 1_TURN
DELAY NONBLOCKING TURNS 1 IF SELF EXISTS_VARIABLE charging DAMAGE ALL_ENEMIES 2.2*INT DARK
e_lantern_eater.message: The Warden drinks the light from the air. Something terrible is coming. Brace yourself!

e_dust_storm.name: Dust Storm
e_dust_storm.action_string:
DAMAGE ALL_ENEMIES 0.8*INT DARK
DEBUFF ALL_ENEMIES SPEED 20 2_TURNS

e_blinding_bloom.name: Blinding Bloom
e_blinding_bloom.action_string:
APPLY ALL_ENEMIES POISON 3_TURNS
DEBUFF ALL_ENEMIES STR 4 3_TURNS
e_blinding_bloom.message: A thousand wings open at once. The air turns to glittering poison.
